propositions: max_consecutive_repeat scores cycles of length >= 2 lower than healthy breadth because it only detects adjacent identical signatures, missing non-adjacent repetition patterns
a windowed distinct-ratio metric computed over trailing tool calls (window=24, trip threshold=0.50) detects all cycle lengths and separates pathological loops from healthy runs with wide margin
_repetition_summary must add distinct_ratio_window field alongside existing counters without changing producer contract or caller interfaces
distinct_ratio_window must return None when fewer than 24 signatures exist to prevent false positives on short sequences
the window size and trip threshold must be exported as module-level named constants (REPETITION_WINDOW, REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO) for use by multiple consumers
